tracks.text: A commuter train cuts across a dense urban landscape.
Commuters look up
More commuters turn
A man in a gray coat removes his hand from a woman's butt.
The Chuo Line arrives at the Nishi-Fukuyama Station

The gray coated man flies out of the train, across the station. The woman steps of the train and calmly walks away. She has shoulder length purple hair, gaunt features, and beady eyes. The crowd stares.
Green, fuzzy parasite eggs resembling viruses float in darkness
Speckles of green light fall from the sky over a vast, urban landscape.
Murano stands between suburban houses, staring left, her back to a camellia bush.
Shinichi stands by powerlines and a crosswalk, staring right, his back to a camellia bush
The two float in a void of shattering glass
Migi's green eye opens.
A web of arteries and neurons pulse red, illuminating text, Parasyte: the maxim
Migi smiles with a toothy mouth in the palm of its hand. A green eye stares from the thumb.
Shinichi steps into water, rippling its reflection of a dark city and red sky. He stares up as buildings, street lights, and power lines float at odd angles.
A crowd crosses and freezes. Flesh monsters covered in eyes and blades erupt from random people.
Two women stand back to back. A flock of butterflies briefly passes, and the women's head grow into a mass of eyes and blades.
Shinichi stands under water, his right hand over his heart.
Amongst the universe, Shinichi stares forward. A boy with short, brown hair stares right.
An older man in a suit stares left
Rows of eyes and teeth and flesh flash. A girl with back length brown hair stares away from us, at a massive, full moon in a cloudy sky.
She looks towards us, opening her brown eyes. In her place, Missus. Izumi stares at us with brown eyes. Lines trace across her face.
In a warm, glowing void, Shinichi embrace Murano, both nude.

Shinichi falls from darkness, passing buildings and lights and metal towers. Faces flash by, depicting a gaunt man, Yuko and a girl, a graying man, blood dripping from teeth, and rows of eyes. Shinichi lands in water under a blue sky. His hair slicked back, he holds out Migi
Morning at the Izumi house. Text, Stage 3, Symposium
Mister Izumi glances at his tablet and leans in. Shinichi and his mother eat.
Murano approaches him on the sidewalk
Migi's eye appears from his collar
The high school
Students stand in neat rows inside the gymnasium. Shinichi looks around amongst his fellow students.
He looks at teachers standing against the wall.
The woman from the train, with shoulder length purple hair, and a tight fitting white suit jacket and skirt, steps across the dais and approaches the podium. She turns to the students.
Their eyes lock. Ryoko's aura is ominous, intense, and other-worldly, like a monster in a dark ocean.
She smirks slightly.
The boys sit in track suits at a sports court.
A plane traces contrails across the sky, reflected in the window of a classroom. Ryoko writes a logarithmic expression on a whiteboard. Shinichi scratches in his notebook, staring at her back.
She turns. He looks away.
The students stare as Shinichi storms off. A girl with freckles pouts.
Shinichi walks down the hall, frowning
Sign reads, Career guidance office
She sits at a table. He approaches her.
She stands. He backs away.
Elsewhere, Yuko and Murano walk across a pedestrian bridge.
They notice Shinichi in a bus

The bus pulls up to a stop. It pulls away, and Shinichi stands on the sidewalk, staring up at a 7 story building labelled City Hotel. Its front is a glass wall filled with a sparkling chandelier. Later, Shinichi looks at his reflection in a cup of coffee.
Ryouko enters with the salaryman from the park.
Ryouko walks up with the beady eyed man
Migi transforms into bladed flesh. A's face unfurls.
The parasite pair sit at the diner style table.
Waitress
Mister A walks off, his teeth sharpening, his eyeballs rolling around.
She puts a spoon in her mouth. Her eye rolls back, and she removes the spoon, curled in a tight roll.
He thinks of Murano
Izumi residence
He stares at himself in the bathroom mirror
He turns on the cold water
Ryouko writes on a whiteboard with neat, steady handwriting, log x 4 minus log 4 x minus 1 equals 0
Ryouko's chalk breaks.
Mister A's face transforms into a flesh tentacle and destroys a security camera.
A teacher slumps, bleeding. The principal approaches.
She glances at Shinichi. He watches her leave.
The teacher grabs Mister A. His face distorts and bats the teacher away. Two others watch as his face reforms.
It splits into bladed tendrils and strikes the two. They fall, bleeding.
Nagai glances out the window
Murano watches as he runs back up the stairs.
He barricades desks in the hallway
Migi expands into a classroom and slices off a leg from a chair. It returns with the makeshift spear.
In the field, Murano looks up at the classroom window
Mister A stands on the 4th floor, staring up.
Flesh tendrils break the window. Mister A lands in the hallway next to Shinichi.
Scattered white clouds float over a pale, blue sky. Various pictures appear in the style of a children's book.
A pink bicycle sits in front of a house.
A bald man walks a golden retriever.
A mom unlocks a door as her children follower her.
Potted plants line an alley in front of a brick house.
A woman waters dozens of potted plants with a hose
A girl stands in front of a gate with a lunch box
A white door with yellow trim
A rose bush grows around a front gate
6 cats sleep in front of a door
A girl with back length hair runs out of a front door, her mother watching
A traditional gate is covered in snow
A woman with shoulder length hair walks into the entryway of a high rise
An elderly couple pray at a small shrine
A bush is neatly trimmed next to sliding doors
A car sits in a car park next to a pair of doors at a duplex
A subway door opens, and a crowd emerges

A single orange flower grows at the base of a tree. Roots stretch out. The trunk of the tree rises higher and higher, eventually branching out as the trunk narrows, hosting enough leaves to block out the sky.
The front gate at the Izumi house lies open. The front door opens, and Shinichi approaches the foyer, wearing glasses, a gray hoodie, and blue sweat pants. He smiles quizzically.
Red text in the window, Parasyte the maxim

Post-episode footnote: The train that pulls into Fukuyama Station bore the logo TR and was white with orange stripes. This aesthetically resembles the real world JR Chuo Rapid line, which runs through Tokyo. The real world Fukuyama station exists in Fukuyama City, Hiroshima, but the trains that service that station are fully one color, rather than the striped colors of the Tokyo trains.
